title: Retry a VCF Installer depot update without duplicate mutation
prompt:
Implement `src/vcf_installer/client.py` as a standard-library-only Python 3.11 client for an idempotently retryable VMware Cloud Foundation Installer 9.1 depot update. Do not add dependencies or edit any other file.

Before implementing, research the VCF Installer operation `updateDepotSettings` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer. Do not call any other route.

Keep the supplied public API:

- `VcfInstallerClient(base_url, access_token, *, timeout=10.0)`
- `VcfInstallerClient.update_depot_settings(download_token, *, download_activation_code=None, max_retries=1) -> dict[str, object]`
- `VcfInstallerError`, raised for invalid input, exhausted or non-retryable HTTP or transport failures, or malformed successful responses

`update_depot_settings` configures the online VMware depot account with a `PUT /v1/system/settings/depot`. Require `download_token` to be a nonblank string of at most 32 characters. When `download_activation_code` is supplied, require a nonblank string and include it; when it is `None`, omit it. Validate `max_retries` as a non-boolean integer from 0 through 5; it is the number of attempts permitted after the first. Retry only HTTP 500 and ambiguous transport failures, stopping when the retry budget is exhausted. Do not retry HTTP 400 or any other HTTP response. A successful response is exactly HTTP 202 with an `application/json` object containing a `vmwareAccount` object whose returned token fields match the submitted values. Return a fresh dictionary decoded from that response. Do not expose either credential in errors.

Make the mutation safe across the commit-before-error window. Serialize the representation once and reuse the same target, header values, and exact body bytes on every attempt. This PUT replaces one stable resource: do not turn retries into POSTs, add an attempt identifier, or otherwise vary the representation.

Honor the exact wire contract. The raw target is exactly `/v1/system/settings/depot`, with no query string or bare `?`. Send compact UTF-8 JSON. With no activation code, the body is exactly `{"vmwareAccount":{"downloadToken":"<runtime value>"}}`. Omit every unset optional schema member: `downloadActivationCode`, `username`, `password`, `status`, and `message` inside `vmwareAccount`, plus top-level `offlineAccount` and `depotConfiguration`. Omission means absent, never blank, null, zero, false, or an empty object. Every attempt has exactly one `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`, one `Accept: application/json`, and one `Content-Type: application/json`; send a fixed `Content-Length`, not chunked transfer encoding.

Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`.
scenario: A replacement of the online depot credentials commits before the first HTTP 500 is returned, so an exact PUT retry must complete without a second semantic effect.
constraint: The contract-pinned loopback request log proves exact retry identity, optional-member omission, and one replacement effect across two updateDepotSettings attempts.
